name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: a local library mapping fed by two RemoteLibrarySources on the *same* friend's server (two of their folders both feeding one local library) could have each source's sync cycle prune the other's just-synced content, since PruneServerSources only ever scoped by (mapping, server) - never by which specific source an item came from. Sources from the same server are now synced together and pruned once per server, using the combined set of everything all of that server's sources actually reported this cycle, so neither one erases the other. Investigated after a report that a Jellyfin friend's declined-to-share content was still coming through; the core per-library enforcement (FederationPeerAccessService, Peer/Libraries, Peer/Items) traced out correct on direct review, and this is the one concrete bug found - it may or may not be the exact case reported, so please confirm once this is running. 281 tests, all green.
